extension.summary: Shows your Home Assistant dashboard in Kodi
extension.description: Brings the contents of the Home Assistant "Home" dashboard into Kodi: your favourites, the light, climate, security, maintenance, weather and energy summaries, and every area grouped by floor. States update live over the WebSocket API, and devices can be switched straight from the couch.

Bringt den Inhalt des Home-Assistant-Dashboards „Home" nach Kodi: deine Favoriten, die Übersichten für Licht, Klima, Sicherheit, Wartung, Wetter und Energie sowie alle Räume nach Etagen gruppiert. Die Zustände aktualisieren sich live über die WebSocket-API, und Geräte lassen sich direkt vom Sofa aus schalten.
extension.news: v1.5.0.1 - Fixed: the dashboard could crash while states were changing - Fixed: camera stills stopped after half an hour with a user name and password - Fixed: the access token was sent to image servers other than Home Assistant - Fixed: a cancelled login or a rejected token left the dashboard reconnecting forever - Fixed: a network blip could force a new login, second factor and all - Fixed: a change made while connecting could be missed - Fixed: an IPv6 address in the Home Assistant URL - Temperatures and numbers take decimals where the entity steps in them; a thermostat holding a range asks for both ends - Summaries follow Home Assistant: the default ones appear even if the shortcut list was never edited, and empty ones are left out - The access token is hidden in the settings
